plain_english: By subtleness, smell etc. five subtle-elements — then by instrumentality from touch — of senses tenfoldness.
sanskrit_cite: sūkṣmatvena ca gandhādipañcatanmātratāṃ tataḥ karaṇatvena saṃsparśād indriyāṇāṃ dvipañcatām

plain_english: Of knowability by covering, subjecthood manifestation in sequence — mind I-intellect-hood of these in non-differentiation predominance, personhood — and contraction expansion which in-dependence.
sanskrit_cite: vedyatāyāḥ chādanena vettṛtodbhāsanakrame mano 'haṃbuddhitāṃ eṣām avibhāge pradhānatām puruṣatvaṃ ca saṃkocavikāsau yadapekṣayā

plain_english: Arose desired from union, from double-form, of-both-self, from will-nature, from opening — otherwise supreme from union.
sanskrit_cite: abhūvann iṣyasaṃyogād dvirūpād ubhayātmanaḥ icchāsvarūpād unmeṣād anyathānuttarāyutāt

plain_english: Four powers inner of spirit, his inside, supporters — of consciousness-space, of inert-ground, of Māyā-made — like Triśaṅku.
sanskrit_cite: catasraś śaktyo 'ntaḥsthāḥ puṃso 'syāntaś ca dhārikāḥ cidvyomno jaḍabhūmeś ca māyāmayyas triśaṅkuvat

plain_english: Of will-power of-three-form, three other powers became — emission this — then exceedingly clear became, created from expansion.
sanskrit_cite: icchāśaktes trirūpāyās tisro 'nyāś śaktyo 'bhavan visargo 'yam athātyarthaṃ sphuṭo 'bhūt sṛjyavistarāt

plain_english: This having-created of self-powers mutual from-mixing may-become agitation — inner not from-this emission outside may-become.
sanskrit_cite: etat sṛṣṭvātmaśaktīnām itaretaramiśrāt bhavet kṣobhāntaraṃ nāsmād visargād bāhyato bhavet
